fusions.name: Tireless Fling
fusions.desc: Throws a hatchet that deals 8 damage. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Mounted Charge
fusions.desc: You rush up to 5 tiles and land a ring blow that deals 13 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Second Wind
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Fresh Legs
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, your physical damage rises by 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
